evals.prompt: Is our payment webhook handler in src/webhook.js safe? Find what's wrong, fix it, and keep the tests passing.
expectations: Finds and fixes the bypass: a request without an x-signature header is processed instead of rejected
Replaces the plain string comparison of signatures with a constant-time comparison (crypto.timingSafeEqual or equivalent)
Verifies the signature over the raw request body, not over JSON.stringify of the parsed event
Adds replay protection: rejects a signature whose timestamp t is outside a tolerance window
Adds at least one negative test (missing, invalid or stale signature is rejected) and runs the tests, which pass
